title: MS Dynamics 365 F&O Functional Consultant
minimumQualification: Candidate has a Bachelor’s degree in any engineering background or in a related field with strong relevant work experience.
jobDescription:
The role offers a legion of chances to explore and use latest technologies in delivering quality assurance to our clients through best process and practices by being pro-active in the position of a Dynamics 365 F&O Functional Consultant. Should be able to analyze business needs and to convert those needs into requirements. Should be able to run Fit-Gap analysis. Should be able to prepare a Business Requirement Document (BRD). Work closely with key stakeholders. Providing user training and support to ensure successful adoption of the Dynamics 365 platform. Candidate has a Bachelor’s degree in any engineering background or in a related field with strong relevant work experience. Hands-on experience in the implementation of Dynamics 365 F&O. Hands-on experience in migrating to D365 F&O from any Legacy systems. Good Knowledge on the General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Procurement and Sourcing, Sales and Marketing Modules, Product Information Management, Inventory Management & Warehouse Management. Hands-on experience in Data import to D365 F&O. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX/365(Finance, Purchase, Sales, Manufacturing). Experience with configuring and designing the workflows. requirements. Should be able to run Fit-Gap analysis. Should be able to prepare a Business Requirement Document (BRD). Good Knowledge on the General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Procurement and Sourcing, Sales and Marketing Modules, Product Information Management, Inventory Management & Warehouse Management. Hands-on experience in Data import to D365 F&O. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX/365(Finance, Purchase, Sales, Manufacturing). Experience with configuring and designing the workflows. MS Dynamics 365 F&O Developer The role offers a legion of chances to explore and use latest technologies in delivering quality assurance to our clients through best process and practices by being pro-active in the position of a Dynamics 365 F&O Developer. Key Responsibility Hands-on with Finance, Accounts receivable, Accounts payable and Retail modules. End-to-end implementation. Hands-on with Batch jobs, Forms and Reports implementation. Hands-on with Integrations (OData, BYOD and Data Lake). Hands-on with E-commerce/POS domain. Hands-on with Production issues and deployments.
